structured_spec.feature_identity: First Real OR Pilot for Bounded Janus Delegation
structured_spec.user_value: Enables safe delegation of low-risk bounded write tasks to a cheaper external worker path while retaining local validation, diff review, and final acceptance control, reducing overhead for trivial changes.
structured_spec.user_action_surface: User triggers janus-quickchange on a pre-allowlisted small change; the system delegates to an external worker, returns a diff, changed-files list, validation evidence, and presents an accept-or-reject handoff to Codex.
structured_spec.system_behavior: On receiving a delegated write request, system validates that the change is in the allowlist and respects file cap and operation constraints. Delegates to the external worker. On success, system returns a reviewable diff, changed-files list, and validation evidence, then hands off to Codex for accept/reject. On any missing artifact, allowlist escape, file-cap escape, delete/rename/move, or validation failure, the system discards the delegated result and falls back to local Codex handling without claiming task completion.
structured_spec.data_persistence: No persistent storage; all artifacts are ephemeral for a single delegation cycle and discarded after accept/reject or fallback.
structured_spec.constraints: Allowlist must be pre-defined; only one tiny quickchange per delegation; no multi-task or architecture-changing writes; no file deletions, renames, or moves; file count capped per delegation.
structured_spec.security_privacy: All changes are on local repository; no credentials or secrets are exposed; delegation does not bypass local validation or review.
structured_spec.edge_cases: If the external worker returns incomplete artifacts (missing diff, changed-files, or validation evidence), discard and fallback. If the change is not in allowlist, reject delegation and fallback. If file cap exceeded, reject delegation. Any delete/rename/move operation triggers fallback. If validation fails, discard and fallback.
definition_of_done: A tiny allowlisted quickchange request is submitted via janus-quickchange.
The request is validated as within allowlist, within file cap, and devoid of delete/rename/move operations.
The delegation to external worker completes and returns a diff, changed-files list, and validation evidence.
The returned artifacts are presented for Codex review with explicit accept/reject handoff.
No authoritative repo writes are performed by the delegation system.
On any failure condition, the system falls back to local Codex handling without claiming task completion.
structured_spec.test_strategy: Unit test allowlist validation, file-cap enforcement, operation restrictions (no delete/rename/move). Integration test delegation success and artifact completeness. Verification that accept/reject handoff works. Test fallback behavior for each failure condition.
structured_spec.out_of_scope: Broad janus-executioner code delegation, test-pipeline write retries, Auto Router, production routing, canonical routing-table updates, Git or release actions, and any multi-task or architecture-changing write attempt.
structured_spec.internal_complexity_breakdown: Low: single bounded delegation with straightforward validation, external call, and fallback; no state machine, no retries, no persistent storage.
